reserveReview.rationale: ZARm remains reserve-backed on its legacy USDm/ZARm Broker/BiPoolManager pool. The issuer backing configuration and MGP-18 identify only GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm as migrated borrower-CDP currencies; XOFm remains on V2. ZARm's collateral composition is the shared reserve portfolio, refreshed by the live adapter. The authored slices retain their 2026-09-04 composition date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API collateral.assets composition fetched on 2026-09-04 and grouped by the Pharos Mento adapter's configured token families
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved basket exposure: every slice is either a tracked stablecoin dependency or a resolved exogenous crypto asset. Chain and token variants are grouped by the Pharos Mento adapter's configured families.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network's volatile native asset, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is a Lido ETH staking receipt, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
ETH is external cryptoasset collateral held by the Mento Reserve (native ETH on Ethereum plus a residual Celo WETH balance), not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Mento Reserve smart contract (Celo), controlled by Mento governance behind the 172800-second timelock

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The shared Mento Reserve is self-custodied in on-chain protocol contracts on Celo under Mento governance (48-hour timelock per the 2026-07-15 access review); there is no third-party custodian, trust, or SPV, so no legal segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness structure exists. Parts of the basket are deployed into yield-bearing positions (sUSDS savings shares, stETH staking), which is protocol-level redeployment of reserve assets rather than custodian rehypothecation; per-asset account segregation inside the reserve contract is not published.
